data.one_liner: Unified API for on-device AI inference using native OS models.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified Dart and Flutter API for on-device AI inference using OS-managed models via native APIs like Apple Foundation Models, Android Gemini Nano, Windows AI Foundry, and Chrome Prompt API. Supports text generation, streaming, tool calling, JSON schemas, and generative UI specs.
use_when: You want on-device AI inference without bundling large model checkpoints.
You need native performance and tool calling on supported platforms.
You want to generate UI modules or structured JSON directly on the device.
avoid_when: Your target devices do not meet the hardware or OS requirements for on-device AI models.
You require guaranteed cloud-hosted model availability across all platforms.
strengths: No app-bundled model checkpoints, reducing app size and leveraging OS-managed assets.
Supports multiple native platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, and Web.
Offers structured outputs, tool calling, and generative UI capabilities.
weaknesses: Requires specific modern OS versions and hardware (e.g., iOS 26+, Copilot+ PC, Desktop Chrome 148+).
Feature availability varies widely across different platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires specific minimum Flutter, Dart, and native OS/SDK versions. Android requires Kotlin 2.3.21 and API 26+. Windows requires MSIX packaging, specific capabilities, and OS/hardware support. Web requires a modern desktop Chrome browser.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose firebase_ai if you prefer cloud-hosted Gemini models instead of depending on on-device OS models.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose llamadart if you want to run custom downloaded Llama models locally rather than relying on OS-managed native models.
